mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that reduces the cost of capital and stimulates equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the average return in triggered periods is not statistically greater than zero (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the unemployment rate above 9.0% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers a flight to safety and reduces equity risk appetite, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in residential construction permits below 580,000 units signals weakening household demand and declining confidence in the housing market, which reduces consumer wealth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when HOUST < 580.0, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 85.0 index points for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real economic output, which signals weakening corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction permits and real personal consumption expenditures signals a broad-based collapse in demand, which triggers a negative feedback loop in equity markets and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stagnant federal funds rate, signals inflationary pressure that may trigger future rate hikes, increasing equity discount rates and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 9.0% and decline in payroll employment below 130,000,000 signals a severe labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 60% of instances when both UNRATE > 9.0% and PAYEMS < 130662.0, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real personal consumption expenditures below 330,000 million dollars, combined with a decline in industrial production, indicates a deepening demand shortfall that undermines corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 60% of instances when both RSAFS < 330000 and INDPRO < 85.0, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.
